This app sends the number of every normal (SIM) call that reaches the shop\'s phone to your POS — a popup appears on the sale screen right away showing which customer is calling and what they bought before. You do not have to keep the app open, the phone just has to be on.\n\nThis build does not catch WhatsApp calls. If you need WhatsApp calls too, get the \"WhatsApp\" app from the download page on the website.
Shop PC (LAN Mode)

If the shop internet goes down, this phone can send calls straight to the shop computer over the same WiFi — the popup keeps appearing on the counter. On that PC, open the NestPOS agent window and turn LAN Mode on; it shows an address and a 6-digit code. Type both here, once.
